items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: So this gal's name was Lucille, and she was playing a piano and we was playing 'Let Me Call You Sweetheart' or something.

ctx.x: So this gal's name was Lucille, and she was playing a piano and we was playing 'Let Me Call You Sweetheart' or something. He says, 'I got a little brother who plays clarinet.
